people.name: Abner
people.line: Saul's cousin and commander of his army

people.name: Rizpah
people.line: Concubine of Saul; mother of Armoni and Mephibosheth

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Now Saul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah; and Ishbosheth said to Abner, “Why have you gone in to my father’s concubine?”
translations.bsb: Now Saul had a concubine named Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah. So Ish-bosheth questioned Abner, “Why did you sleep with my father’s concubine?”
translations.kjv: And Saul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah: and Ishbosheth said to Abner, Wherefore hast thou gone in unto my father's concubine?
